title: Probe into Unauthorised Access of Vendor-managed SLA Platform Containing Real Personal Data
what_it_is: Probe into Unauthorised Access of Vendor-managed SLA Platform Containing Real Personal Data

sections.label: SLA STARS ELS data set
sections.summary: IBM maintained SLA's STARS and ELS; a 1998 test data set was found to contain unanonymised personal information, and contractual action is pending.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: IBM was the vendor appointed to support and maintain the Singapore Land Authority's (SLA's) Singapore Titles Automated Registration System (STARS) and the eLodgment System (ELS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The affected environment was separate from SLA's live operational systems, which were not affected.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The data set was created in 1998 for major system tests and updated periodically over the subsequent years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Although the data set was intended to contain only mock and anonymised testing data based on property ownership and lodgement records, SLA subsequently uncovered that the data set contained personal information which was not anonymised.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: STARS and ELS are subject to regular audits, with the most recent audit carried out in 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The appropriate contractual action will be determined after the full facts and respective responsibilities have been established.

sections.label: 2025 audit scoping
sections.summary: The 2025 audit was set by a late-2024 risk-based scoping exercise, and the incomplete anonymisation was not identified during it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Turning to the second question about audit, I would like to clarify that the 2025 audit was determined through a risk-based scoping exercise that was conducted in late 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: The incomplete anonymisation was not identified during the audit.
